_position_sizing_note: Risk-based sizing: each trade risks risk_per_trade_pct of equity, sized by ATR distance. max_position_pct caps the dollar exposure.
_signal_note: Trend-pullback strategy. Regime gate (ADX) + trend (SMA) + timing (RSI pullback) + VWAP alignment.
_exit_note: ATR-based stops/targets give 2:1 reward-to-risk by default. Even at 50% win rate, expectation is positive.
